title: English's Internet Share Fell From 75% To 45%
hook: English fell from 75% of web pages to under half.
closing: Your language still decides how much of the web you see.
question: Which language dominates your feed?

segments.say: English held 75 percent of web pages before the rest of the world logged on.
Arabic content grew 2,501 percent, rapidly changing the internet's language mix.
English now covers 55 percent of websites, leaving nearly half outside its reach.
